messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026-0421 for service=redwood-inference-canary — 5xx rate > 2% over 1m on canary fleet. Dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/d/alerts/canary-5xx

pagerduty-bot: AUTO-PAGE -> paging maria on rotation (policy: canary-critical) :rotating_light:

maria: Ackd. looking

sam: @maria i'm on the deploy that went out ~03:12 UTC — dark launch traffic-v2 rolled to 10%. seeing p95 jump ~1.6s and 502s start at 03:13. rolling window shows spike correlated to canary hosts.

josh: oncall here — seeing same in logs. can you confirm which image/tag we pushed?

sam: pushed image registry.redwood/inference:v2026-03-15-tokenizer-v2

maria: ok. @sam @josh we should consider immediate rollback. if 502s >2% for >1m PD will escalate. i'm going to try traffic cut first then rollback if no quick improvement. @oncall-sre can you stand by for routing change?

oncall-sre: standing by. ready to switch traffic to baseline.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation scheduled in 5m if unacked/unresolved.

sam: starting routing change to move canary traffic -> 0% new variant via router API now

sam: command:```bash
# set canary traffic to 0%
curl -X POST https://router.redwood.internal/api/v1/traffic -d '{"route":"inference","variant":"v2","percent":0}'
```

josh: logs (tail) showing tokenizer crash pattern — repeated: 
```
2026-03-15T03:13:22Z ERROR tokenizer-service panic: out-of-memory handling long-seq (len=8192)
stack: ...
502 response -> upstream/tokenizer/parse
```

maria: seeing immediate drop after routing change: 5xx rate down to 0.7% p95 0.95s. great. keep monitoring for 5m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria at 1765012360 — auto-escalation suppressed.

elaine: product note: support ticket inflow shows ~120 customers attempted requests in EU region during spike; about ~8% hit an error. I'll draft a short customer message, but waiting for final numbers.

josh: quick repro locally with v2 image on long sequences — OOM threshold lower due to changed token buffer allocation. suspect tokenizer binary change.

sam: preparing rollback patch: pin tokenizer binary back to v1 and bump memory limit for next canary. working on image tag v2026-03-15-tokenizer-v2-hotfix (actually v1-pinned).

maria: for now we keep traffic at 0% for v2 and mark canary as aborted. we'll not roll forward until we validate memory behaviour under load.

sam: rollback command executed:```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/canary-deploy --to-revision=2
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/canary-deploy tokenizer=registry.redwood/inference:tokenizer-v1
```

maria: confirming deployment stabilized. p95 steady ~0.9s, 5xx under 0.5%. closing immediate on-call loop.

elaine: customer comms: posting a short status note to status.redwood.ai: "Short spike of 5xx for EU customers during canary deploy; root cause under investigation; no data loss; rollout paused." will send to support.

josh: root-cause hypotheses: tokenizer v2 allocation changes + some long-sequence workﬂows; will run fuzz tests and memory profiling.

maria: next steps: owner @josh for RCA, @sam to build hotfix image and run internal soak for 4h, I'll schedule a postmortem. severity: sev3 -> customer impact small but visible for some EU traffic. notify legal/compliance if any.

oncall-sre: handing off to day oncall in AM. leaving monitoring runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/canary-5xx

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status changed -> resolved (auto: all canary traffic reverted, no active regression in baseline).

maria: thanks team. quick sync tomorrow 09:30 to review RCA and rollout plan. :thumbsup:

elaine: posting final blurb to #customer-impact and support.

pagerduty-bot: Incident closed at 1765012780.
